//go:build nativeintegration

package integration_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"
	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/domain"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

const learningAnalyticsStream = "LEARNING_ANALYTICS_EVENTS"

func TestNativeTelemetryLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	baseURL := setting("STATISTIC_NATIVE_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:18090")
	clickHouseDSN := setting("STATISTIC_NATIVE_CLICKHOUSE_DSN", "tcp://127.0.0.1:19000?database=default")
	natsURL := setting("STATISTIC_NATIVE_NATS_URL", "nats://127.0.0.1:4222")
	internalToken := setting("STATISTIC_NATIVE_INTERNAL_TOKEN", os.Getenv("STAT_INTERNAL_TOKEN"))
	if internalToken == "" {
		t.Fatal("explicit native internal token is required for the session-summary proof")
	}

	client := &http.Client{Timeout: 5 * time.Second}
	requireHealthy(t, client, baseURL)
	assertInternalSummaryGuard(t, client, baseURL, internalToken)

	clickHouse := openClickHouse(t, clickHouseDSN)
	defer func() { _ = clickHouse.Close() }()

	natsConnection, err := nats.Connect(natsURL, nats.Timeout(5*time.Second))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("connect NATS: %v", err)
	}
	defer natsConnection.Close()
	jetStream, err := natsConnection.JetStream()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("open JetStream: %v", err)
	}
	before, err := jetStream.StreamInfo(learningAnalyticsStream)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read %s: %v", learningAnalyticsStream, err)
	}

	userID := uuid.New()
	courseID, lessonID, taskID := uuid.New(), uuid.New(), uuid.New()
	eventID := uuid.New()
	defer cleanupFixture(t, clickHouse, jetStream, userID, eventID)

	sessionID := startSession(t, client, baseURL, userID, courseID, lessonID, taskID)
	// Server timestamps must span a full second so the Int64 active-time
	// projection is tested with a positive value as well as count aggregates.
	time.Sleep(1100 * time.Millisecond)
	postInterestingEvent(t, client, baseURL, userID, courseID, lessonID, taskID, sessionID, eventID)

	waitFor(t, 10*time.Second, func() error {
		var count uint64
		query := fmt.Sprintf("SELECT count() FROM stat_events WHERE user_id = toUUID('%s')", userID)
		if err := clickHouse.QueryRow(context.Background(), query).Scan(&count); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if count != 2 {
			return fmt.Errorf("expected two ClickHouse rows, got %d", count)
		}
		return nil
	})

	assertSummary(t, client, baseURL, userID, courseID, lessonID, taskID)
	assertInternalSessionSummary(t, client, baseURL, internalToken, userID, sessionID)
	if sequence := findNATSFixture(t, jetStream, before.State.LastSeq+1, eventID); sequence == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("did not find JetStream message for event %s", eventID)
	}
}

func internalSummaryResponse(t *testing.T, client *http.Client, baseURL, token string, studentID, sessionID uuid.UUID) *http.Response {
	t.Helper()
	endpoint := fmt.Sprintf("%s/internal/v1/students/%s/learning-sessions/%s/summary", strings.TrimRight(baseURL, "/"), studentID, sessionID)
	request, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("create internal session-summary request")
	}
	if token != "" {
		request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
	}
	response, err := client.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("internal session-summary request failed")
	}
	return response
}

func assertInternalSummaryGuard(t *testing.T, client *http.Client, baseURL, token string) {
	t.Helper()
	studentID, sessionID := uuid.New(), uuid.New()
	for _, provided := range []string{"", token + "-invalid"} {
		response := internalSummaryResponse(t, client, baseURL, provided, studentID, sessionID)
		_ = response.Body.Close()
		if response.StatusCode != http.StatusUnauthorized {
			t.Fatalf("internal summary must reject absent/incorrect token, got HTTP %d", response.StatusCode)
		}
	}
}

func assertInternalSessionSummary(t *testing.T, client *http.Client, baseURL, token string, studentID, sessionID uuid.UUID) {
	t.Helper()
	response := internalSummaryResponse(t, client, baseURL, token, studentID, sessionID)
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		_ = response.Body.Close()
		t.Fatalf("internal session-summary regression: HTTP %d", response.StatusCode)
	}
	var decoded struct {
		Summary *domain.LearningSessionSummary `json:"summary"`
	}
	decodeJSON(t, response, &decoded)
	summary := decoded.Summary
	if summary == nil || summary.StudentID != studentID || summary.AnalyticsSessionID != sessionID || summary.PolicyVersion != "learning-analytics-active-time-v1" {
		t.Fatal("internal session-summary identity or policy differs")
	}
	if summary.StartedAt.IsZero() || summary.LastActivityAt.Before(summary.StartedAt) || summary.WallClockSeconds < 1 || summary.ActiveLearningSeconds < 1 || summary.ActiveLearningSeconds > 60 || summary.ActiveLearningSeconds > summary.WallClockSeconds {
		t.Fatal("internal session-summary active time is outside the nonnegative capped projection")
	}
	if summary.PassedTestCount != 1 || summary.FailureCount != 0 || summary.LessonCount != 0 || summary.TaskCount != 0 || summary.QuestionCount != 0 || summary.SelectedExplanationCount != 0 || summary.CodeRunCount != 0 || summary.HintCount != 0 || summary.TeacherInterventionCount != 0 || summary.StuckSignalCount != 0 {
		t.Fatal("internal session-summary event counts differ from the exact telemetry fixture")
	}
	for _, scope := range [][2]uuid.UUID{{uuid.New(), sessionID}, {studentID, uuid.New()}} {
		response := internalSummaryResponse(t, client, baseURL, token, scope[0], scope[1])
		if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
			_ = response.Body.Close()
			t.Fatalf("empty internal session-summary scope: HTTP %d", response.StatusCode)
		}
		decodeJSON(t, response, &decoded)
		if decoded.Summary != nil {
			t.Fatal("internal session-summary leaked another student or session")
		}
	}
}

func setting(name, fallback string) string {
	if value := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name)); value != "" {
		return value
	}
	return fallback
}

func requireHealthy(t *testing.T, client *http.Client, baseURL string) {
	t.Helper()
	response, err := client.Get(strings.TrimRight(baseURL, "/") + "/internal/health")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("native health request: %v", err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("native health status: %s", response.Status)
	}
}

func openClickHouse(t *testing.T, rawDSN string) clickhouse.Conn {
	t.Helper()
	parsed, err := url.Parse(rawDSN)
	if err != nil || parsed.Host == "" {
		t.Fatalf("parse ClickHouse DSN: %v", err)
	}
	database := parsed.Query().Get("database")
	if database == "" {
		database = "default"
	}
	connection, err := clickhouse.Open(&clickhouse.Options{
		Addr:     []string{parsed.Host},
		Protocol: clickhouse.Native,
		Auth:     clickhouse.Auth{Database: database},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("open ClickHouse: %v", err)
	}
	if err := connection.Ping(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ping ClickHouse: %v", err)
	}
	return connection
}

func startSession(t *testing.T, client *http.Client, baseURL string, userID, courseID, lessonID, taskID uuid.UUID) uuid.UUID {
	t.Helper()
	payload := map[string]any{
		"course_id":   courseID,
		"lesson_id":   lessonID,
		"task_id":     taskID,
		"platform":    "d8-native-proof",
		"editor_mode": "code",
		"payload":     map[string]any{"fixture": "d8-wave3-statistic"},
	}
	response := postJSON(t, client, baseURL+"/api/v1/stat/session/start", userID, payload)
	var decoded struct {
		Data struct {
			SessionID uuid.UUID `json:"session_id"`
		} `json:"data"`
	}
	decodeJSON(t, response, &decoded)
	if decoded.Data.SessionID == uuid.Nil {
		t.Fatal("session start did not return a session ID")
	}
	return decoded.Data.SessionID
}

func postInterestingEvent(t *testing.T, client *http.Client, baseURL string, userID, courseID, lessonID, taskID, sessionID, eventID uuid.UUID) {
	t.Helper()
	payload := map[string]any{
		"course_id":   courseID,
		"lesson_id":   lessonID,
		"task_id":     taskID,
		"platform":    "d8-native-proof",
		"editor_mode": "code",
		"events": []map[string]any{{
			"event_id":   eventID,
			"session_id": sessionID,
			"event_type": "test_passed",
			"payload": map[string]any{
				"active_seconds":       480,
				"same_error_count":     0,
				"consecutive_failures": 0,
			},
		}},
	}
	response := postJSON(t, client, baseURL+"/api/v1/stat/events", userID, payload)
	var decoded struct {
		Data struct {
			Accepted int `json:"accepted"`
		} `json:"data"`
	}
	decodeJSON(t, response, &decoded)
	if decoded.Data.Accepted != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected one accepted event, got %d", decoded.Data.Accepted)
	}
}

func postJSON(t *testing.T, client *http.Client, endpoint string, userID uuid.UUID, payload any) *http.Response {
	t.Helper()
	body, err := json.Marshal(payload)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("marshal request: %v", err)
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create request: %v", err)
	}
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Id", userID.String())
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "student")
	response, err := client.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("post %s: %v", endpoint, err)
	}
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK && response.StatusCode != http.StatusAccepted {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
		_ = response.Body.Close()
		t.Fatalf("post %s: %s: %s", endpoint, response.Status, body)
	}
	return response
}

func decodeJSON(t *testing.T, response *http.Response, destination any) {
	t.Helper()
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if err := json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(destination); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode response: %v", err)
	}
}

func assertSummary(t *testing.T, client *http.Client, baseURL string, userID, courseID, lessonID, taskID uuid.UUID) {
	t.Helper()
	query := url.Values{
		"course_id": []string{courseID.String()},
		"lesson_id": []string{lessonID.String()},
		"from":      []string{time.Now().Add(-time.Minute).UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano)},
		"to":        []string{time.Now().Add(time.Minute).UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano)},
	}
	endpoint := fmt.Sprintf("%s/api/v1/stat/summary/task/%s?%s", strings.TrimRight(baseURL, "/"), taskID, query.Encode())
	request, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create summary request: %v", err)
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Id", userID.String())
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "student")
	response, err := client.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("get summary: %v", err)
	}
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
		_ = response.Body.Close()
		t.Fatalf("summary response: %s: %s", response.Status, body)
	}
	var decoded struct {
		Data map[string]json.RawMessage `json:"data"`
	}
	decodeJSON(t, response, &decoded)
	if string(decoded.Data["summary"]) == "null" || len(decoded.Data["summary"]) == 0 {
		t.Fatal("summary projection is empty")
	}
}

func findNATSFixture(t *testing.T, jetStream nats.JetStreamContext, firstSequence uint64, eventID uuid.UUID) uint64 {
	t.Helper()
	var found uint64
	waitFor(t, 10*time.Second, func() error {
		info, err := jetStream.StreamInfo(learningAnalyticsStream)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for sequence := firstSequence; sequence <= info.State.LastSeq; sequence++ {
			message, err := jetStream.GetMsg(learningAnalyticsStream, sequence)
			if err == nats.ErrMsgNotFound {
				continue
			}
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if bytes.Contains(message.Data, []byte(eventID.String())) {
				found = sequence
				return nil
			}
		}
		return fmt.Errorf("fixture event is not present in stream")
	})
	return found
}

func cleanupFixture(t *testing.T, clickHouse clickhouse.Conn, jetStream nats.JetStreamContext, userID, eventID uuid.UUID) {
	t.Helper()
	if err := clickHouse.Exec(
		context.Background(),
		fmt.Sprintf("ALTER TABLE stat_events DELETE WHERE user_id = toUUID('%s') SETTINGS mutations_sync = 1", userID),
	); err != nil {
		t.Errorf("delete exact ClickHouse fixture: %v", err)
	}
	info, err := jetStream.StreamInfo(learningAnalyticsStream)
	if err != nil {
		t.Errorf("read stream for cleanup: %v", err)
		return
	}
	for sequence := info.State.FirstSeq; sequence <= info.State.LastSeq; sequence++ {
		message, messageErr := jetStream.GetMsg(learningAnalyticsStream, sequence)
		if messageErr == nats.ErrMsgNotFound {
			continue
		}
		if messageErr != nil {
			t.Errorf("read NATS fixture during cleanup: %v", messageErr)
			return
		}
		if bytes.Contains(message.Data, []byte(eventID.String())) {
			if deleteErr := jetStream.DeleteMsg(learningAnalyticsStream, sequence); deleteErr != nil {
				t.Errorf("delete exact NATS fixture: %v", deleteErr)
			}
			return
		}
	}
}

func waitFor(t *testing.T, timeout time.Duration, check func() error) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
	var lastErr error
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		if err := check(); err == nil {
			return
		} else {
			lastErr = err
		}
		time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	t.Fatalf("condition did not converge: %v", lastErr)
}
